resources.string: Fixes Bluetooth audio drifting behind video by briefly pausing and resuming playback, which flushes the audio delay without disconnecting your device.
Start your video, then tap Reset Sync.
Done ✓ If it\'s still off, try a longer pause.
Nothing is playing. Start your video first.
Bluetooth permission denied, so auto-reset is off.
Tile is in your Quick Settings.
Tile not added. You can add it by editing your Quick Settings panel.
Start around 1000 ms. If sync isn\'t fixed, raise it step by step. Around 3000–4000 ms usually forces the audio output fully idle, which is the strongest reset.
Auto-reset 4 s after a Bluetooth audio device connects (only if something is playing)
The tile lets you reset from the notification shade without leaving your video.
